findings.desc: smoke-coverage-gap: adversarial-review-contract-smoke.ts does not import or construct CompletenessCriticIO — the wrapper interface is exported (adversarial-review.ts:144) but never referenced in the smoke, so the runtime coverage claim in CHK-002:edge evidence relies solely on tsc, not a smoke assertion

smoke-coverage-gap: adversarial-review-contract-smoke.ts does not import or construct ReviewModeRound — the interface is exported (adversarial-review.ts:182-184) but never referenced in the smoke, so CHK-003:edge evidence note claim "ReviewModeRound exported" is only backed by tsc, not a runtime assertion

MAJOR: LENS_IDS/CANONICAL_LENS_SET use hyphenated ids (concept-scope/behavior-correctness/crash-safety-edge) but the FROZEN spec §2.1 canonical lens ids are the slash forms (concept/scope, behavior/correctness, crash-safety/edge). These are STRING LITERALS (slashes are valid in strings — the 'invalid identifier' rationale is wrong), so the contract must match §2.1 VERBATIM (no translation layer) per the acceptance. Fix: change the 3 ids to slash form (concept/scope, behavior/correctness, crash-safety/edge); code-quality/test-coverage/docs-consistency already match; update CANONICAL_LENS_SET + the smoke expected ids.
